dct_title_s: Official map of the county of San Mateo, California : showing the new boundary line and delineating the lines of cities, towns, private claims, ranchos, water works and rail roads
dct_description_sm: carefully compiled [by] J.J. Cloud, County Survr., S.M. Co. ; drawn by Walter Montagu Kerr.
Shows drainage, township and section lines, land ownership, ranchos, school districts, tide lands, etc.
"Approved by the Board of Supervisors, January 1877."
Oriented with north to the left.
Inset map: Political townships of San Mateo County. Scale [1:253,440]. 4 miles to 1 in.
